next_source_opportunity.findings: The pinned HIP helper computes its workgroup predicate but has no return; this selector therefore always chooses the common kernel. Intent and performance of the alternate kernel remain unverified.
next_source_opportunity.helper_source:
def use_w8a8_block_fp8_matmul_unrolledx4(M, N, META):
        # Use manually unrolledx4 kernel on AMD GPU when the grid size is small.
        # Empirical testing shows the sweet spot lies when it's less than the # of
        # compute units available on the device.
        num_workgroups = triton.cdiv(M, META["BLOCK_SIZE_M"]) * triton.cdiv(
            N, META["BLOCK_SIZE_N"]
        )
        num_workgroups <= get_device_core_count()
